arxiv-2208-13981.title: Comments on “Time-Varying Lyapunov Functions for Tracking Control of Mechanical Systems With and Without Frictions”
arxiv-2208-13981.creator: OLALEKAN OGUNMOLU 1
arxiv-2208-13981.description: Abstract In the article 1 1 1 Ren, W., Zhang, B, Li, H, and Yan L. Time-Varying Lyapunov Functions for Tracking Control of Mechanical Systems With and Without Frictions . IEEE Access, vol. 8. pp. 51510-51517. 2020. , the authors introduced a time-varying Lyapunov function for the stability analysis of nonlinear systems whose motion is governed by standard Newton-Euler equations.

arxiv-2301-06190.title: BuildSeg: A General Framework for the Segmentation of Buildings
arxiv-2301-06190.creator: Lei Li, Tianfang Zhang, Stefan Oehmcke, Fabian Gieseke, Christian Igel
arxiv-2301-06190.description: Abstract Building segmentation from aerial images and 3D laser scanning (LiDAR) is a challenging task due to the diversity of backgrounds, building textures, and image quality. While current research using different types of convolutional and transformer networks has considerably improved the performance on this task, even more accurate segmentation methods for buildings are desirable for applications such as automatic mapping.

arxiv-2302-07749.title: Luminosity distance uncertainties from gravitational wave detections of binary neutron stars by third generation observatories
arxiv-2302-07749.creator: Josiel Mendonça Soares de Souza, Riccardo Sturani
arxiv-2302-07749.description: Abstract A new generation of terrestrial gravitational wave detectors is currently being planned for the next decade, and it is expected to detect most of the coalescences of compact objects in the universe with masses up to a thousand times the solar mass.

arxiv-2401-05174.title: Collider imprints of right handed neutrino magnetic moment operator
arxiv-2401-05174.creator: Eung Jin Chun, Sanjoy Mandal, Rojalin Padhan
arxiv-2401-05174.description: Abstract We consider most general effective Lagrangian up to dimension five, built with Standard Model (SM) fields and right-handed neutrinos (RHNs) N i N_{i} . Assuming that the RHNs are present near the electroweak scale, we study the phenomenology of the RHNs and highlight the differences that arise due to the inclusion of dimension five operators.

arxiv-2403-15825.title: Generalized nonlinear Langevin equation from quantum nonlinear projection operator
arxiv-2403-15825.creator: Jin Hu
arxiv-2403-15825.description: Abstract We systematically derive the quantum generalized nonlinear Langevin equation using Morozov’s projection operator method. This approach extends the linear Mori-Zwanzig projection operator technique, allowing for the inclusion of nonlinear interactions among macroscopic modes. Additionally, we obtain the quantum generalized Fokker-Planck equation within the Heisenberg picture, which is consistent with Morozov’s original formulation.

arxiv-2410-17351.title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Cyber Network Defense Conference: Preprint, Under Review; October 2024; United States
arxiv-2410-17351.creator: Aditya Vikram Singh 1 , Ethan Rathbun 1 , Emma Graham 2 , Lisa Oakley 1 , Simona Boboila 1 , Alina Oprea 1 , Peter Chin 2
arxiv-2410-17351.description: Abstract . Recent advances in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) have created opportunities to solve complex real-world tasks. Cybersecurity is a notable application area, where defending networks against sophisticated adversaries remains a challenging task typically performed by teams of security operators.

arxiv-2503-11415.title: Explaining the emission lines in early-type galaxies
arxiv-2503-11415.creator: Grażyna Stasińska
arxiv-2503-11415.description: Abstract We explore the hypothesis that the weak emission lines observed in some early-type galaxies (ETGs) are due to ionization by hot low-mass evolved stars (HOLMES) and analyze the pros and cons. \lefttitle Cambridge Author \righttitle Proceedings of the International Astronomical Union: L a T e X Guidelines for authors \jnlPage 17 \jnlDoiYr 2025 \doival 10.

arxiv-2503-16061.title: Efficient Service Differentiation and Energy Management in Hybrid WiFi/LiFi Networks
arxiv-2503-16061.creator: Asim Ihsan, Muhammad Asif, Hossein Safi, Iman Tavakkolnia, Harald Haas
arxiv-2503-16061.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose an innovative predict-and-optimize algorithm designed for hybrid WiFi/LiFi networks, aiming to achieve service differentiation while maximizing energy efficiency (EE). The proposed framework utilizes multi-access technology real-time intelligent controller (mATRIC) to dynamically predict the appropriate network slice for each user based on historically monitored key performance indicators (KPIs).

arxiv-2505-23953.title: Enhancing LLM-Based Code Generation with Complexity Metrics: A Feedback-Driven Approach
arxiv-2505-23953.creator: Melika Sepidband, Hamed Taherkhani, Song Wang, Hadi Hemmati
arxiv-2505-23953.description: Abstract Automatic code generation has gained significant momentum with the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-4. Although many studies focus on improving the effectiveness of LLMs for code generation, very limited work tries to understand the generated code’s characteristics and leverage that to improve failed cases.

arxiv-2510-07922.title: SketchGuard: Scaling Byzantine-Robust Decentralized Federated Learning via Sketch-Based Screening CCS: Security and privacy Systems security
arxiv-2510-07922.creator: Murtaza Rangwala, Farag Azzedin, Richard O. Sinnott, Rajkumar Buyya
arxiv-2510-07922.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Murtaza Rangwala, Farag Azzedin, Richard O. Sinnott, Rajkumar Buyya. Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative training without centralized servers, but remains vulnerable to Byzantine attacks where malicious clients submit corrupted model updates. Existing Byzantine-robust DFL defenses rely on similarity-based neighbor screening that requires every client to exchange and compare complete high-dimensional model vectors with all neighbors in each training round, creating prohibitive communication and computational costs that prevent deployment at web scale.

pmc-10641173.title: A bibliometric analysis of primary Sjögren's syndrome-associated lymphoma from 1991 to 2022
pmc-10641173.creator: Tzuhua Wu, Shangdian Li, Jiaqi Chen, Jiahe Liao, Ziwei Huang, Jianying Yang, Yan Zhang, Qian He, Xinbo Yu, Weijiang Song, Jing Luo, Qingwen Tao
pmc-10641173.description: BackgroundPatients with primary Sjögren's syndrome (pSS) take a higher risk of developing lymphoma, which is the most frequent cause of death in pSS. Based on this situation, the number of publications focusing on pSS-associated lymphoma has been growing. Nevertheless, the extent, range, and nature of available research in this field have not been systematically summarized.

pmc-10919436.title: Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) as a marker of coronary lesion severity in stable coronary artery disease (CAD) patients
pmc-10919436.creator: Cut A Andra, Aldy S Rambe, Refli Hasan, Rosita Sembiring, Doni Firman, Putri C Eyanoer, Zulfikri Mukhtar, Taufik Sungkar, Muhammad Rusda, Mustafa M Amin
pmc-10919436.description: Coronary artery disease (CAD) remains a significant global health concern with considerable high morbidity and mortality and its development is influenced by various genetic and environmental factors. Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) is a vital regulator of low-density lipoprotein receptor (LDLR) metabolism, directly impacting serum cholesterol levels. However, its role in development of CAD is not fully understood.

pmc-12580245.title: The Impact of Lower Extremity Mechanical Axis Alignment on the Success of Platelet‐Rich Plasma Injections in Knee Osteoarthritis Patients
pmc-12580245.creator: Alparslan Yurtbay, Furkan Erdoğan, Ferhat Say
pmc-12580245.description: ObjectivesKnee osteoarthritis (OA) is a common cause of pain and disability, and conventional conservative treatments often provide only limited and temporary relief. Platelet‐rich plasma (PRP) injections have emerged as a promising biological therapy; however, patient response is highly variable, and biomechanical factors such as lower extremity malalignment may influence treatment outcomes.

pmc-12581057.title: Integrating the smoke-free app into a multicomponent intervention for people with mental health conditions who smoke: a short report of a service-improvement project
pmc-12581057.creator: Emily Shoesmith, Lisa Huddlestone, Jodi Pervin, Petal Petersen Williams, Jennifer Sweetman, Kerry Johns, David Crane, Louise Ross, Elena Ratschen
pmc-12581057.description: BackgroundEvidence on designing and testing digital interventions for patients with mental health conditions is emerging. However, little is known about supporting patient needs and mitigating risks when offering smoking cessation apps in this population. We aimed to identify patient support needs and factors influencing patient safety when interacting with the Smoke Free app.

pmc-12596992.title: Comprehensive dataset of global innovation index panel data (2013–2022): Clustering with K-means and principal component analysis
pmc-12596992.creator: Edilvando Eufrazio, Helder Costa
pmc-12596992.description: Over the last decade, innovation has become a focal point for policymakers, business leaders, and researchers worldwide. In that context, this dataset draws on the annual Global Innovation Index (GII), compiled by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and available on the World Bank's Prosperity Data360 portal, to offer a refreshed view of national innovation landscapes.
